visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The shot opens with a first-person view of a hand holding a small yellow cardboard box featuring a PChome logo and a minimalist cartoon face. The hand is steady against a background of a modern white dining table and a grey sectional sofa. The lighting is bright and even, reflecting a well-lit indoor home environment. (2) A woman with blonde-streaked hair in two braids and a white Mardi Mercredi t-shirt sits at the table, smiling brightly. Two young girls lean in from the left, their faces filled with curiosity and excitement. The yellow parcel is placed on the white tabletop, becoming the central focus of the frame. (3) The woman uses a small silver box cutter to carefully slice through the clear packing tape on top of the yellow box. Her hands, decorated with light-colored nail art, move with precision. The background remains the living room setting, with soft shadows and the girls' eager faces peering over the table. (4) After opening the box flaps, the woman removes layers of clear plastic bubble wrap. The camera pans slightly to follow her movements as she reaches deep into the box. Her facial expressions transition from concentration to amusement as the girls chatter and watch her hands closely. (5) A small white and black perfume box labeled YSL Mon Paris is revealed inside. A man's hand enters the frame to hold the tiny perfume packaging next to the larger delivery carton to emphasize its small size. The white tabletop provides a clean, neutral background for this close-up reveal. (6) The woman unboxes the miniature perfume bottle, which features a tiny black decorative bow. She holds it up with her fingers, laughing and looking directly at the camera with wide eyes. Text overlays in Traditional Chinese appear at the bottom, and the girls' hands reach toward the small object.
